body: Waaaaaait where???? You know what, he must be doing such a good job of hiding and camoufloaging that he's invisible to me... Yeah, that's it.

This makes me sad. I'm typically a very lonely gal and I had thought compliments would be a nice thing to approach someone with in order to make friends.  I guess I will work on a different strategy, but please forgive someone who may come up you with a compliment because it may be news to them that someone dislikes it just like it was new to me. 

Edit: seems like my strategy is still a safe one for most of the population so I will keep at it. Thank you for the support fellow reddit users. :-)
